From: "Delgado, Anjanette" <adelgado@freepress.com>
Date: Thursday, October 11, 2018 at 9:27 AM
To: DFP_Everybody <DFP_Everybody@freepress.com>
Subject: Next week
Next week we’ll begin individual audience strategy sessions for all reporters with their editors.
Reporters, confer with your editor and sign up for a time that works for both of you here. You will both be at the same session together.
Sessions are 30 minutes long and there’s roughly an hour of homework to do in advance.
The homework:

Prepare to tell us about your audience. For whom are you writing? Keep in mind the Gannett audience segments from Tovah’s training here.
Prepare to tell us what’s working and what’s not on your beat, and what you’re doing to adjust. Look at your own data to see what types of stories resonate and what don’t. Tovah has additional data to help you prepare.
Bring your research notes to the session for discussion; no need to prepare anything formal or send anything ahead of time.
We’re also going to go through a beat exercise that came from one of your colleagues’ suggestions at the Fewer Things sessions in September.
Questions? Just ask.
Anjanette
